title: fix(i18n): flow node and screen step labels match the locale tag like the flow label
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9Gqqp1VYZwEqbXEm1YsTjU)_
Fixes #36808
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziH9MVhWYLVCiw5eXB

## 维护者速读

- 流程设计器与文档里画出的流程图:语言标记大小写与翻译包不同(如会话为小写的简体中文标记)时,普通步骤名和未设标题的界面步骤名现在也显示译名,之前显示作者原文。
- 属于流程步骤名多语言一致性收尾,与上一轮审批步骤名的修复对齐,让所有步骤名与流程名取译名的方式一致。
- 出错时只会让流程图上的步骤显示作者原文而非译名,不影响流程运行,可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/flowLabels.ts`: `flowLabelTranslations` picks the bundle row for the `nodes.NODE_ID.label` and `screens.NODE_ID.title` reads (both `stepLabel` and `screenTitle`) with the spec's `resolveBundleLocale(bundle, language)` (`@objectstack/spec/system`), instead of indexing `bundle[language]` by the exact key. `resolveBundleLocale` is the locale ladder the spec's `pickData` runs for each locale `translateFlow` (flow label) and `resolveFlowApprovalStepLabel` (approval step label) consult under `{ locale: language }`, so all three reads now pick the same row: a `zh-cn` session reads a `zh-CN` row. One locale only, no fallback chain (that is a separate card). The `flows.FLOW.nodes.NODE_ID.label` addressing (ruling 7076440876) is unchanged.
- No spec export added; no public type or export of `@object-ui/i18n` changed.

Read first (by risk): 1. the `locale` / `flow` lines in `flowLabelTranslations`; 2. the new test `flowLabels-step-locale-36808.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/flowLabels-step-locale-36808.test.ts` — expect 3 passed.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/flowLabels-step-locale-36808.test.ts`, one bundle keyed `zh-CN`: a `zh-cn` session reads the plain node label and the untitled screen's title (and `screenTitle`); the exact-key `zh-CN` session reads the same as before; a locale the bundle does not carry (`fr`) answers nothing.

<details><summary>Readings at head 7a7d1ed8f</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/` — Test Files 109 passed (109), Tests 2014 passed, 13 skipped; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check` exit 0 (the new test is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program, `--listFiles` count 1). Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the `flow` line put back to the exact-key `bundle[language]` read (anchor 1 -> 0, blob 5130034c -> b86c0914): new test file 1 failed / 2 passed, the failing case is the `zh-cn` case; restored, blob after restore equals HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../flowLabels` from source, so no dist rebuild is involved.
- Local gates, all exit 0: adr-0087 registration, changeset-no-major, empty-changeset, nul-bytes, cross-package-test-inputs, test-source-alias, changeset-fixed, undeclared-dep-imports, closing-keyword-parity. `overlap-check`: VERDICT clean. The other 30 derived families, Type Check UI and Test UI are CI's (declared narrowing).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `resolveBundleLocale` runs the whole platform ladder (exact, case-insensitive, platform table language, base language, variant), exactly as the flow label and the approval step label already did; so a `zh` session also reaches a `zh-CN` row for node and screen labels now. That is the "same way" the card asks for, not a fallback chain: one locale is still consulted.

## Verification

Local subset at head 7a7d1ed8f as listed above; the full gate farm is CI's.
